INVITE FOR Q2FY27 EARNINGS CALL OF IPCA LABORATORIES LTD 
THURSDAY, 5TH NOVEMBER, 2026 AT 16:00 HRS IST 
Ipca Laboratories Limited (BSE: 524494, NSE:IPCALAB) will organize a conference call for 
investors and analysts on Thursday, 5th November, 2026 from 16:00 hrs to 17:00 hrs IST 
to discuss Q2FY27 earnings and business update. The conference call follows the 
announcement of the Company’s Q2FY27 unaudited financial results on Thursday, 5th 
November, 2026. 
Ipca Laboratories Limited management will be represented by Mr. A K Jain – Managing 
Director  and Mr. Harish Kamath – Corporate Counsel & Company Secretary.
